description: The South African Department of Basic Education publishes EMIS masterlists through its official download page. These are administrative facility registers; the date and level of each release must be selected explicitly, not assuming all listed files form one current snapshot. Published by Department of Basic Education. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. The provider page is the access route; underlying file formats were not confirmed. Reuse licence: Unknown; no data or software reuse licence established from the reviewed metadata.
